insights.title: Chiller 2 Compressor Drive-End Bearing Friction Warning
insights.insight: Centrifugal Chiller 2 (CH-02) drive-end bearing vibration RMS has trended upward from 1.4 mm/s to 3.8 mm/s over 72 hours, with temperature reaching 59.5°C.
insights.why: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) vibration telemetry indicates peak amplitude at ball-pass inner ring frequency (BPFI), indicating raceway spalling.
insights.risk: Unmitigated operation will lead to catastrophic shaft seizure, unexpected chiller trip during peak heat hours, and emergency replacement costs exceeding $65,000.
insights.recommendation: Schedule ultrasonic grease injection and vibration spectrum re-scan within 48 hours; stage Chiller 3 (CH-03) to take base load.
insights.impact: Extends bearing life by ~6,000 run hours, prevents unexpected HVAC shutdown, and preserves $18,400 in emergency repair and business disruption costs.
